Overview

This feature service provides the storm drainage pipe inventory maintained by Westbank First Nation (WFN) . It supports viewing and managing stormwater conveyance assets within the WFN area.

Feature Layer

WFN Storm Pipes contains line features representing stormwater assets such as pipes, culverts, ditches, perforated pipe, watercourse segments, service connections, and catch basin leads. The layer includes asset identifiers, pipe type, material, diameter, installation date, status, location, ownership, source notes, comments, jurisdiction, and elevation-related attributes for upstream and downstream inverts and rims.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Westbank First Nation area in the Central Okanagan region of British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Stormwater asset inventory and maintenance
  • Drainage planning and infrastructure management
  • Field verification and operational updates
  • Support for mapping, inspection, and asset tracking workflows

Access and Licensing

Created and maintained by WFN and distributed under Regional District of Central Okanagan open data terms and disclaimer.
